question: In Warframe, which deals more damage per shot on its normal attack, the Hek or the Tigris Prime? Give both values.
answer:
**The Tigris Prime deals more damage per shot.**

- **Tigris Prime:** 1,560 total per shot (8 pellets × 195). Its damage is 80% Slash.
- **Hek:** 525 total per shot (7 pellets × 75). Its damage is 65% Puncture.
- Per pellet, the Tigris Prime also leads, 195 to 75.

These are base values at full range, before falloff and mods. The source is the infobox data on the Warframe Wiki pages for [Hek](https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Hek) and [Tigris Prime](https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Tigris_Prime), read from the local KB synced 2026-11-24.
